name: Meta Platforms
thesis: Ad-targeting efficiency flywheel (Advantage+, Reels monetization, WhatsApp click-to-message, Threads emerging) compounds as Llama becomes a distribution lever for both ads and platform stickiness. The thesis explicitly excludes Reality Labs as a return driver — RL is a long-dated option, not a thesis pillar; the model should work even if RL stays at zero. The bet: (1) FoA revenue growth holds 10%+ CC, (2) consolidated op margin holds 35%+ even as capex compounds, (3) RL operating loss stays bounded relative to FoA op income growth.
key_driver: Family of Apps revenue growth + capital allocation discipline (RL bounded vs FoA op income)

tier_1_kpis.name: Ad price/impression ratio
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Price declining while impressions flat (demand-side weakness)

tier_1_kpis.name: Family DAP (daily active people) growth
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Flat or declining in developed markets

tier_1_kpis.name: Reality Labs operating loss
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: RL loss expanding faster than FoA op income growth (capital allocation discipline test)

tier_1_kpis.name: Capex guidance + AI ROI commentary
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Capex up + ad-efficiency metrics not improving (2022 redux signal)

nuance.bear_case: EU DMA remedies could force a data silo between apps, degrading Advantage+ targeting performance. TikTok US continuing operations + share gains compounds the Reels vs TikTok competition. A 2022-redux capex cycle without revenue response is the singular tail risk.
nuance.adversarial_take: RL is the discipline test — if losses keep expanding faster than FoA op income growth, the 'option value' framing collapses into 'undisciplined capital allocation' and the thesis is held under stricter HUMAN_CAPITAL_OVERLAP standard anyway.
nuance.stress_test: FoA revenue <10% CC + RL loss expansion outpacing FoA op income for 2 consecutive Qs would force a multiple re-rate.

thesis_breakers_qualitative: EU DMA remedies force data silo between apps (targeting degradation)
TikTok US operations continue + gain share
Capex cycle without revenue response (2022 redux)
Reality Labs operating loss expanding faster than FoA op income growth
flags: HUMAN_CAPITAL_OVERLAP — thesis held to stricter standard per Correlation Filter

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
GAAP operating margin negative for 2 consecutive quarters — operating loss.
Gross margin below 20% for 2 consecutive quarters — severe pricing/cost issue.
GAAP net income negative for 2 consecutive quarters — bottom-line loss.
